summary: Local repository family plan for splitting address morphism theory and broader address research into specialized, publication-safe repositories.
commonPromotionGates: repository creation preflight before any remote action

repositories.name: address-morphism-theory
repositories.createRationale: AMT already has enough manuscripts, executable reference models, claim maps, and verification notes to stand alone outside AGID product code.
owns: AMT I and AMT II manuscripts
local manuscript and PDF build scripts
doesNotOwn: private address, recipient, witness, proof-secret, private-key, or production credential material
requiredPromotionGates: existing seed repository remains locally verifiable
AGID compatibility links are left in place until public publication
remote owner preflight passes before any GitHub creation
no raw private material is included

repositories.name: address-research
repositories.specialization: research agenda, methodology, and source catalog repository
repositories.createRationale: General address research needs a neutral home that is not mixed with AMT paper authorship, product code, or country-pack data production.
doesNotOwn: private address, recipient, witness, proof-secret, private-key, or production credential material
requiredPromotionGates: research notes are redacted and public-safe
claims are labeled as verified, hypothesis, or non-claim
remote owner preflight passes before any GitHub creation

repositories.name: address-morphism-benchmarks
repositories.createRationale: Split only after AMT and Address Research share enough reusable synthetic fixtures to justify an independent benchmark package.

repositories.name: address-source-catalog
repositories.specialization: public source metadata and license ledgers
repositories.createRationale: Split only after address-research accumulates enough source metadata to need separate maintainers and release gates.

repositories.name: address-quality-research
repositories.specialization: address quality methodology and evaluation rubrics
repositories.createRationale: Split only after quality research has independent fixtures, reports, and credible non-claim boundaries.
